definitions.explanation: A professional photography studio where portraits, family photos, and commemorative photographs are taken.

examples.japanese: {写真館|しゃしんかん}で{家族|かぞく}{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}った。
examples.english: We had a family photo taken at a photo studio.

examples.japanese: {七五三|しちごさん}の{記念|きねん}に{写真館|しゃしんかん}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I booked a photo studio for our Shichi-Go-San commemoration.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}の{写真館|しゃしんかん}は{証明|しょうめい}{写真|しゃしん}も{撮|と}ってくれる。
examples.english: The photo studio in front of the station also takes ID photos.

examples.japanese: {成人式|せいじんしき}の{前|まえ}に{写真館|しゃしんかん}で{振袖|ふりそで}の{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}る{人|ひと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many people have their furisode photos taken at a studio before Coming of Age Day.

notes:
Composed of {写真|しゃしん} (photograph) + {館|かん} (hall/building). Photo studios in Japan are commonly used for milestone events: {七五三|しちごさん}, {成人式|せいじんしき}, weddings, school entrance ceremonies, and graduation. They differ from casual photo printing shops in that they offer professional lighting, backdrops, and sometimes costume rental.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写真館|しゃしんかん}で{撮|と}る: have a photo taken at a studio
- {写真館|しゃしんかん}を{予約|よやく}する: book a photo studio
- {記念|きねん}{写真|しゃしん}: commemorative photo
- {証明|しょうめい}{写真|しゃしん}: ID/passport photo
- {前撮|まえど}り: advance photo session (before the event)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- フォトスタジオ: photo studio (modern/trendy branding)
- {写真|しゃしん}{屋|や}: photo shop (can also mean a casual print shop)
